codex.name: Codex (GPT)
codex.description: OpenAI GPT models via Codex CLI - specialized expert subagents
codex.auth: codex login (codex login --device-auth on a remote machine), or CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN
codex.note: No dedicated MCP server - codex-cli ships no MCP server mode. GPT is served by the unified `deliberation` server, which spawns `codex exec` (core/providers/codex.js).

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.description: Google Gemini via a Google AI Studio API key; the Antigravity CLI (agy) is the opt-in path and runs workspace-write - specialized expert subagents
gemini.install: No install for the API key path. Optional: Antigravity from https://antigravity.google (read https://antigravity.google/terms section 6 first)
gemini.auth: export GEMINI_API_KEY=... (key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey; GOOGLE_API_KEY also works), or run `agy` once and complete sign-in for the opt-in agy path

grok.name: Grok (xAI)
grok.description: xAI Grok models via bundled MCP bridge over the xAI HTTP API - advisory expert subagents

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway to 400+ models via a bundled MCP bridge - config-driven advisory delegates
openrouter.auth: export OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-... (or the env var named by apiKeyEnv)
